home.title: How many kilograms per shift?
home.subtitle: Drag the load range: matching models step forward and the catalog filters itself.

home.step2Body: Send a request with selected models; we prepare a specification and commercial proposal from the form.

home.flagshipLead: Key washers across load bands — from compact to industrial.
home.flagshipBadge: Availability and lead times are confirmed in the quote
home.advantage1Body: Intelligent load weighing (Auto Weight): automatic adjustment of water, chemicals, and energy.
home.advantage2Body: High spin reduces residual moisture and shortens drying time.
home.advantage3Body: Industrial components designed for daily continuous duty in commercial and industrial laundries.
home.advantage4Body: Genuine spare parts in Ukraine and on-site engineer visits.

floorPlanner.title: Floor layout planner
floorPlanner.lead: Top view: rectangles from W×D dimensions. Drag, rotate, or remove a machine from the plan.
floorPlanner.quote: Get a quote for these models
floorPlanner.hint: Arrow keys move the selected machine by 50 mm (or pan the plan when none is selected), R rotates, Delete removes it from the plan. +, −, 0 zoom; Ctrl+wheel or pinch also zoom.

categoryIntros.washers: Industrial washers for hotels, hospitals, and commercial laundries. Compare models by load in kilograms, heating type, and dimensions.
categoryIntros.dryers: Dryers for different shift volumes and heating types. Match drum size and power so drying does not bottleneck the wash line.
categoryIntros.flatwork-ironers: Flatwork ironers for bed linen and large textiles. Use working width and throughput speed as the primary filters.
categoryIntros.laundry-carts: Carts for moving soiled and clean linen inside the laundry. They help shape zone-to-zone logistics without extra handling.
categoryIntros.ironing-rollers: Ironing rollers for finishing table linen and mid-format textiles. Compare shaft width and line throughput.
categoryIntros.finishing: Finishing equipment — from presses to dedicated stations. Completes the cycle after drying and ironing.
categoryIntros.water-recovery: Water-recovery systems to cut consumption in industrial laundries. Sized to the washer circuit and local connections.
categoryIntros.washer-dryers: Washer-dryers in one cabinet — when floor space is tight but you still need a full cycle without a separate drying zone.
categoryIntros.mobile-laundry: Modular mobile laundries for temporary and remote sites. Compare kit contents and connection power. (needs-review)

privacy.intro: This page describes only what the request form on this site does. A full legal policy will replace this after lawyer review.

about.title: About the company
about.lead: Operating since 1994. Official supplier of industrial laundry equipment from FAGOR PROFESSIONAL in Ukraine.
about.historyBody: For more than three decades we have helped hotels, hospitals, commercial and central laundries build lineups around real linen volume per shift. From the first consultation through commissioning and service we stay an on-site engineering partner — without loud promises we cannot confirm in a quote.
about.expertiseBody: We specialise in Fagor Professional industrial laundry equipment: washers, dryers, finishing, and related machinery. The on-site catalog is built so a buyer can quickly compare models by kilograms, heating, and dimensions.
about.infraBody: Office and warehouse in Vyshneve (Kyiv region): we support on-site projects, logistics of original parts, and equipment pickup by prior arrangement.
about.standardsBody: We size equipment to linen volumes per shift, support installation, and provide technical assistance without invented “24/7” or minute-based SLA claims — timelines and terms are agreed in the quote and the service request.
about.ctaBannerBody: Send a request — we will prepare a commercial proposal from the selected models and site conditions.
about.enReviewNote: English copy is a neutral draft and needs review.

service.title: Service and support
service.lead: Describe the equipment and the issue—we will pass the request on. No SLA or warranty claims until those are confirmed separately.
service.checklist1: Find the model in the catalog or write the name from the plate.
service.checklist2: Note the serial number if it is on the machine.
service.checklist3: Briefly describe the symptom and operating conditions.
service.process1Body: An engineer reviews symptoms, any error code, and the data on the equipment nameplate.
service.process2Body: We check availability of original parts and schedule a service visit.
service.process3Body: Faults are fixed, industrial units are serviced preventively, and wash programs are adjusted.
service.process4Body: Load testing, reporting, and warranty on the work performed and parts installed.
service.techLead: Direct phone and email will appear here once confirmed.
service.faq1A: Model, serial number from the nameplate, and a symptom description or error code.
service.faq2Q: Do you use original Fagor parts?
service.faq2A: Yes. We use original Fagor components from stock or order them from the manufacturer.
service.faq3Q: Do you service equipment not bought from you?
service.faq3A: Yes. We service and repair industrial laundry equipment from Fagor Industrial.
